add_component.behavior: Immediately adds and selects a new child Component under selected parent; no modal
add_component.evidence: Child actually added; Quantity observed, not edited

add_material.behavior: Opens reference search, NOT new Material creation

add_material.evidence: Published material selected and attached in unsaved tree

add_substance.parent: Editable own Material, not referenced published Material
add_substance.selection: Exact CAS cell inside row of dialog Detail
add_substance.evidence: Nickel CAS 7440-02-0 attached to own unsaved Material; form Type Basic Substance verified
